# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(IRanges)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(writexl)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
region_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "combp_region")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results")
model_dir <- file.path(save_dir, "linear_model")
dmr_dir <- file.path(save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs")
out_dir <- file.path(save_dir, "sensitivity_analysis")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Overview

Four comparisons of the primary analysis with the `Smoking_Adjusted` analysis
(memory residual additionally adjusted for the SSc DNAm smoking score):

1. **CpG, uncorrected:** the significant individual CpGs, interaction estimate,
   SE and P-value before BACON (`02a`).
2. **CpG, BACON:** the same CpGs, BACON-adjusted values (`02b`).
3. **DMR, overlapping regions:** the significant primary DMRs (`02d`) against
   the smoking-adjusted comb-p regions that overlap them (`02c`/`02d`, run with
   `--seed 0.05 --region-filter-p 1.0`, no significance filter).
4. **DMR, fixed regions:** the significant primary DMRs retested with
   `comb-p region_p` on the same boundaries, with primary and with
   smoking-adjusted P-values (`03a`).

Each comparison is saved as a CSV and as one sheet of
`Smoking_Sensitivity_Comparisons.xlsx`, together with a summary sheet.

# Define Functions

## Helpers

```{r func_helpers}
get_direction <- function(estimate) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    estimate > 0 ~ "+",
    estimate < 0 ~ "-",
    TRUE ~ "."
  )
}

# "chr1:100-200" -> chr, start, end (keeps the DMR column)
split_dmr <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(
      cols = "DMR", delim = ":", names = c("chr", "pos"), cols_remove = FALSE
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(
      cols = "pos", delim = "-", names = c("start", "end")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      start = as.integer(.data$start),
      end = as.integer(.data$end)
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame()
}

# GRanges from the chr, start and end columns of a data frame
make_granges <- function(df) {
  GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = df$chr,
    ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = df$start, end = df$end)
  )
}

# Left join cond_df onto base_df by overlapping genomic ranges. A primary DMR
# that overlaps several regions gets one row per overlapping region.
merge_by_overlap <- function(base_df, cond_df) {
  hits <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(
    make_granges(base_df), make_granges(cond_df)
  )
  overlap_df <- data.frame(
    base_id = S4Vectors::queryHits(hits),
    cond_id = S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)
  )

  base_df <- base_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(base_id = dplyr::row_number())
  cond_df <- cond_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cond_id = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c("chr", "start", "end"))

  base_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(overlap_df, by = "base_id") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(cond_df, by = "cond_id") %>%
    dplyr::select(-"base_id", -"cond_id")
}
```

## CpG Comparisons

```{r func_cpg}
get_significant_cpgs <- function() {
  read.csv(file.path(dmr_dir, "interact_mQTLs_inputs.csv")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$Sources %in% c("DMR and Individual CpG", "individual CpG")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull("cpgs")
}

# corrected = FALSE: 02a output (EAP_stats.csv), *_interact columns
# corrected = TRUE:  02b output (EAP_stats_bacon_interact.csv), *_bacon columns
read_cpg_stats <- function(prefix, corrected, analysis) {
  if (corrected) {
    fname <- paste0(prefix, "EAP_stats_bacon_interact.csv")
    cols <- c("estimate_bacon", "std_error_bacon", "pvalue_bacon")
  } else {
    fname <- paste0(prefix, "EAP_stats.csv")
    cols <- c("estimate_interact", "std_error_interact", "pvalue_interact")
  }

  stats_df <- read.csv(file.path(model_dir, fname))
  out_df <- data.frame(
    CpG = stats_df$CpG,
    Estimate = stats_df[[cols[1]]],
    StdErr = stats_df[[cols[2]]],
    pValue = stats_df[[cols[3]]]
  )
  out_df$direction <- get_direction(out_df$Estimate)
  colnames(out_df)[-1] <- paste0(analysis, "_", colnames(out_df)[-1])

  out_df
}

get_cpg_annotation <- function() {
  read.csv(file.path(model_dir, "EAP_stats.csv")) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "CpG", "Chr", "Position", "UCSC_RefGene_Name", "GREAT_annotation"
    )
}

compare_cpgs <- function(corrected) {
  cpg_ls <- get_significant_cpgs()

  get_cpg_annotation() %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$CpG %in% cpg_ls) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      read_cpg_stats("", corrected, "Primary"), by = "CpG"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      read_cpg_stats("Smoking_Adjusted_", corrected, "Smoking"), by = "CpG"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Estimate_change_pct = 100 *
        (.data$Smoking_Estimate - .data$Primary_Estimate) /
        abs(.data$Primary_Estimate),
      Same_direction = .data$Primary_direction == .data$Smoking_direction
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$Primary_pValue)
}
```

## DMR Comparisons

```{r func_dmr}
read_dmr_stats <- function(fname, analysis) {
  read.csv(file.path(dmr_dir, fname)) %>%
    split_dmr() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "chr", "start", "end",
      "{analysis}_DMR" := "DMR",
      "{analysis}_nProbes" := "n_probes",
      "{analysis}_pValue" := "P.value",
      "{analysis}_Sidak-P" := "Sidak.P",
      "{analysis}_direction" := "direction"
    )
}

get_primary_dmrs <- function() {
  read.csv(file.path(dmr_dir, "interact_DMRs.csv")) %>%
    split_dmr() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "DMR", "chr", "start", "end", "UCSC_RefGene_Name", "GREAT_annotation",
      Primary_nProbes = "n_probes",
      Primary_pValue = "P.value",
      `Primary_Sidak-P` = "Sidak.P",
      Primary_direction = "direction"
    )
}

# Comparison 3: significant primary DMRs vs overlapping smoking-adjusted regions
compare_dmr_overlap <- function() {
  base_df <- get_primary_dmrs()
  cond_df <- read_dmr_stats("Smoking_Adjusted_interact_DMRs.csv", "Smoking")

  merge_by_overlap(base_df, cond_df) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Smoking_significant = .data$`Smoking_Sidak-P` < 0.05
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-"chr", -"start", -"end")
}

# direction string of the BACON interaction estimates of the CpGs in each region
add_region_direction <- function(region_df, prefix) {
  stats_df <- read.csv(
    file.path(model_dir, paste0(prefix, "EAP_stats_bacon_interact.csv"))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(.data$Chr %in% c("chrX", "chrY"))) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$Chr, .data$Position)

  region_gr <- make_granges(region_df)
  cpg_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = stats_df$Chr,
    ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = stats_df$Position, width = 1)
  )
  hits <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(region_gr, cpg_gr) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      direction = get_direction(stats_df$estimate_bacon[.data$subjectHits])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data$queryHits) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(direction = paste0(.data$direction, collapse = ""))

  region_df <- region_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(queryHits = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(hits, by = "queryHits") %>%
    dplyr::select(-"queryHits")

  region_df
}

read_region_retest <- function(label, prefix, analysis) {
  fname <- file.path(region_dir, label, "interact_dmrs_retested.bed")

  readr::read_table(fname, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::rename(chr = "#chrom") %>%
    add_region_direction(prefix) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(nProbes = nchar(.data$direction)) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "chr",
      "start",
      "end",
      "{analysis}_nProbes" := "nProbes",
      "{analysis}_pValue" := "slk_p",
      "{analysis}_Sidak-P" := "slk_sidak_p",
      "{analysis}_direction" := "direction"
    )
}

# Comparison 4: the 03a region_p retests on the significant DMR boundaries
compare_dmr_region <- function() {
  base_df <- get_primary_dmrs() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "DMR", "chr", "start", "end", "UCSC_RefGene_Name", "GREAT_annotation"
    )
  primary_df <- read_region_retest("Primary", "", "Primary_retest")
  smoking_df <- read_region_retest(
    "Smoking_Adjusted", "Smoking_Adjusted_", "Smoking_retest"
  )

  merge_by_overlap(base_df, primary_df) %>%
    merge_by_overlap(smoking_df) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Same_direction =
        .data$Primary_retest_direction == .data$Smoking_retest_direction,
      Smoking_significant = .data$`Smoking_retest_Sidak-P` < 0.05
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-"chr", -"start", -"end")
}
```

## Summary

```{r func_summary}
summarize_cpg <- function(df, comparison) {
  data.frame(
    Comparison = comparison,
    Loci = nrow(df),
    Same_direction = sum(df$Same_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    Primary_significant = sum(df$Primary_pValue < 1e-5, na.rm = TRUE),
    Smoking_significant = sum(df$Smoking_pValue < 1e-5, na.rm = TRUE),
    Significance_rule = "P < 1e-5",
    Estimate_correlation = stats::cor(df$Primary_Estimate, df$Smoking_Estimate),
    Max_abs_estimate_change_pct = max(abs(df$Estimate_change_pct), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

summarize_dmr <- function(df, comparison, primary_col, smoking_col) {
  data.frame(
    Comparison = comparison,
    Loci = dplyr::n_distinct(df$DMR),
    Rows = nrow(df),
    Unmatched = sum(is.na(df[[smoking_col]])),
    Primary_significant = sum(df[[primary_col]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    Smoking_significant = sum(df[[smoking_col]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    Significance_rule = "Sidak-P < 0.05"
  )
}
```

# Run Comparisons

## CpGs

```{r run_cpg}
cpg_raw_df <- compare_cpgs(corrected = FALSE)
cpg_bacon_df <- compare_cpgs(corrected = TRUE)

stopifnot(nrow(cpg_bacon_df) == length(unique(cpg_bacon_df$CpG)))
cat("Significant individual CpGs:", nrow(cpg_bacon_df), "\n")
```

## DMRs

```{r run_dmr}
dmr_overlap_df <- compare_dmr_overlap()
dmr_region_df <- compare_dmr_region()

cat("Significant DMRs:", dplyr::n_distinct(dmr_overlap_df$DMR), "\n")
```

## Summary

```{r run_summary}
summary_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summarize_cpg(cpg_raw_df, "1. CpG, uncorrected"),
  summarize_cpg(cpg_bacon_df, "2. CpG, BACON"),
  summarize_dmr(
    dmr_overlap_df, "3. DMR, overlapping regions",
    "Primary_Sidak-P", "Smoking_Sidak-P"
  ),
  summarize_dmr(
    dmr_region_df, "4. DMR, fixed regions (region_p)",
    "Primary_retest_Sidak-P", "Smoking_retest_Sidak-P"
  )
)

summary_df
```

# Save

```{r save}
write.csv(
  cpg_raw_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "Smoking_CpG_Comparison_uncorrected.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  cpg_bacon_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "Smoking_CpG_Comparison_bacon.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  dmr_overlap_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "Smoking_DMR_Comparison_overlap.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  dmr_region_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "Smoking_DMR_Comparison_region.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    Summary = summary_df,
    CpG_uncorrected = cpg_raw_df,
    CpG_bacon = cpg_bacon_df,
    DMR_overlap = dmr_overlap_df,
    DMR_region = dmr_region_df
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, "Smoking_Sensitivity_Comparisons.xlsx")
)
```
